name: Planet Labs (PL)
teaser: Do not add. Planet Labs fell 78% from its June high, but at $11.37 the price still needs about 23% growth a year for a decade at bull-case margins; my Base is $1.67 and there is no buy price yet.
llms: Planet Labs PBC (PL) operates the largest fleet of Earth imaging satellites and sells daily imagery, analytics and, increasingly, satellites and data to defense and government customers. Valued with a ten-year free cash flow model that counts stock-based pay and satellite capital spending in full and treats prepaid revenue like debt, with a revenue multiple as a check only. Down 78% from its June 2026 high, the price still implies about 23% revenue growth a year for ten years at bull-case margins. Bear $0, Base $1.67, Bull $7.92. Verdict Hold at $11.37 (November 5, 2026 close), do not add, no buy price.
